consequence.statement: Certificate expiration metrics from Citadel will now accurately reflect the current certificate expiration times when new certificates are loaded, rather than stale values from previously loaded certificates.

original.statement: The citadel_server_root_cert_expiry_timestamp, citadel_server_root_cert_expiry_seconds, citadel_server_cert_chain_expiry_timestamp, and citadel_server_cert_chain_expiry_seconds metrics now update when new certificates are loaded.

decision.reason: [ev-40e9ce81a63d] says the four citadel_server_*_expiry_* metrics now update when new certificates are loaded. The note file is named stale-cert-expiration-metrics, which supports the reading that these values used to go stale. Nothing fails, is rejected or must be migrated. The metrics just report different, now-correct values, so behavior-change at low severity is the right fit: dashboards or alerts built on these metrics may act differently and are worth checking.
